- **Step 2 (ambiguity)**: Issue #4518 had an empty body (no larch:plan); the only signal was the title "single-target consecutive retry sums instead of deduping".
  **A**: Fixed `harness_ci_timing._split_shard_attempts` to split single-target shard rows one-attempt-per-row so `shard_totals_per_run` dedupes consecutive retries to the latest attempt instead of summing. Multi-target retry/multi-bash heuristic left unchanged.

- **Step 2 (ambiguity)**: Issue #4518 had an empty body (no larch:plan); the only signal was the title "single-target consecutive retry sums instead of deduping". Needed to pin down the exact bug and the intended fix.
  **A**: Mapped to `harness_ci_timing.shard_totals_per_run`. A single-target shard (one heavy target per slice, e.g. test-harnesses-1) replays its lone target on retry, so the rows repeat consecutively; `_split_shard_attempts` misread the repeat as a multi-bash continuation and summed every attempt. Fix: rows that all share one target are split one-attempt-per-row so the caller keeps only the latest (dedupes). Multi-target shards keep the existing non-consecutive-repeat heuristic unchanged. A theoretical single-target *multi-bash* shard (none exist in the repo) would be mis-split toward dedup; chose dedup per the title's explicit "deduping" intent.
